params.1273: Harvest a crop of tomatoes from a vegetable patch.
params.1274: Tomatoes are grown from tomato seeds, three at a time. You can pickpocket these from master farmers (with sufficient Thieving), buy them, or play Vinesweeper for them.
params.1275: Head to a vegetable patch to plant them.
params.1276: Tomatoes can be used in Cooking recipes. If you plant marigolds next to the vegetable patch, your tomatoes will be immune to disease.
